description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330200056488 SEAL,NONMETALLIC SP: Line 0001 Qty 147 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0067 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 22. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved source is L0782 AC86195-34. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
